helpDraw: d                        turn one card from the stock
helpMoveWF: m w f                    waste to a foundation
helpMoveWT: m w t <col>              waste to a tableau column
helpMoveTF: m t <col> f              tableau to a foundation
helpMoveTT: m t <from> t <to> [idx]  tableau to tableau (idx = head of the run, default top)
undoToEscape: Undo {{count}} move(s) to escape the dead end (undo {{count}}, or repeat u)
helpExampleAuto: ac                       send everything that can go to a foundation
errNotPlaying: The game is not in play.
errNoCardsInStock: There are no cards in the stock.
errCannotPlaceTableau: That card cannot be placed on the tableau.
errCannotPlaceFoundation: That card cannot be placed on the foundation.
errBadFromColumn: That source column does not exist.
errBadToColumn: That destination column does not exist.
errSameColumn: The source and destination columns are the same.
errInvalidCardIndex: That column has no card at that index.
errNotSameSuitDescending: The cards do not form a same-suit descending run.
errNoAutoCompleted: No cards can be automatically moved.
errNothingToUndo: There is no move to undo.
errSnapshotArrayTooLarge: The snapshot array exceeds the maximum allowed size.
errSnapshotPileTooLarge: A snapshot pile exceeds the maximum allowed size.
errInputArrayTooLarge: The input array exceeds the maximum allowed size.
